confirmed_findings.finding: Native adapter explicitly reports supportsSentHistory() false and throws unsupported_history. AI person recommendation must fail closed before provider access; ordinary discovery and idea capability remain separate.

With zend.exception_ignore_args=0, forbidden __unserialize methods retain their unredacted array argument in exception traces. Three synthetic probes reproduced the issue. Implementer notified to mark the input SensitiveParameter. The implementer added SensitiveParameter on all three inputs; the independent 80-check gateway run now passes.

Nonempty candidate pool initially rejected valid empty model selection. Product design explicitly permits zero selected cards (发现推荐与Agent工具设计.md:312). Validator was aligned and the independent zero-selection check now passes.

Invalid structured QueryIntent arguments are retained in exception traces; answer and cancel may expose unwrapped dependency exceptions. Reproduced with zend.exception_ignore_args=0 using synthetic markers only.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Structured intent parameters are marked sensitive; answer returns a bounded failed view on dependency failure; cancel maps dependency failure to a bounded application exception.

confirmed_findings.finding: Repeated GET of a cancelled run increments its version, and an in-flight run marked failed by a nested GET can later publish completed items with the stale failure code still set. Reproduced failed -> completed with 3 items after a one-shot synthetic policy error during reranking.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Terminal reads preserve state/version and failed runs cannot publish late provider results. Independent reentry and cancellation probes pass.
